rules.statement: The defendant is estopped from asserting that the delivery period ended on a certain date when he led the plaintiff to believe by letter and conduct that the contract was still subsisting, especially since the plaintiff acted on this belief at serious expense.
rules.supporting_quote: Inasmuch as the defendant led the plaintiff to-believe by letter, as well as conduct, that the contract was still subsisting, and inasmuch as the plaintiff acted on that belief at serious expense to himself, it would be unjust to allow the defendant to assert that the delivery period ended on November 15.
